description: Source code for helper functions related to RBUS and CCSP dynamic tables, including path conversion, context management, and synchronization timing.

methods.name: ConvertPath
methods.description: Converts a given path by replacing aliases using hash maps.

methods.name: GetParentContext
methods.description: Retrieves the parent context object for a given path.

methods.name: GetRowContext
methods.description: Retrieves the context associated with a specific row path.

methods.name: SetRowContext
methods.description: Sets the context for a specific row, with optional alias handling.

methods.name: RemoveRowContextByInstNum
methods.description: Removes row context based on table name and instance number.

methods.name: RemoveRowContextByName
methods.description: Removes row context based on row name.

methods.name: IsTimeToSyncDynamicTable
methods.description: Determines if it's time to synchronize a dynamic table based on last sync time.

methods.name: GetParamName
methods.description: Extracts parameter name from a full path.

methods.name: Context_Init
methods.description: Initializes context hash maps if not already initialized.

methods.name: Context_Release
methods.description: Releases and destroys context hash maps when no longer needed.

methods.name: GetHandlerContext
methods.description: Creates a handler context object with full name, parameter name, and user data.
